summary: Daily Journal Corp filed an 8-K after a September 10, 2026 special meeting where holders approved eliminating cumulative voting in director elections, effective with South Carolina Articles of Amendment filed September 11, 2026. The board also adopted amended and restated bylaws adding proxy access for passive holders owning 3% for three years to nominate up to two directors or 20% of seats, plus a South Carolina exclusive forum clause, modernized 60-day advance notice, and clarified shareholders cannot call special meetings. Quorum was 848,577 shares. No deal terms or advisor were stated; watch governance and activist implications.
